services.name: Canoe Rentals
services.desc: If you're comparing Blackwater River canoe rentals in Escambia County and wondering what you actually get for the day, here's the plain answer: you check in mid-morning, we shuttle you upstream, and you drift back down to our landing by 5 p.m. Most groups spend four to six hours on the water, and a good chunk of that is spent parked on a white sand bar. Here's how a real day with us goes, hour by hour. Most folks roll in between 9 and 10. You'll park at our landing on Shammah Road in Holt, an easy drive east from Pensacola and Milton, and check in at the office. services.name: Tube Rentals
services.desc: Floating the Blackwater River by tube is one of the most laid-back outdoor adventures in Northwest Florida. Launch from our private riverside location in Milton and enjoy a slow, scenic drift through crystal-clear water surrounded by pine trees and white-sand banks. Whether you're tubing solo, with friends, or bringing the whole family, our float trips are the perfect way to cool off and connect with nature - all just minutes from Crestview, Holt, and Pensacola. Tubing at Blackwater Joe’s isn’t just a float - it’s your chance to relax, recharge, and enjoy one of Florida’s most scenic rivers.
